messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@topspin.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing exception request — TopSpin AWS co-sell bundle

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team was excited about the latency/cost profile for the multi-tenant model. TopSpin asked us to price a bundled private offer on AWS Marketplace (inference + 6 months of SRE). They indicated they need a 35% list discount to match their procurement guidelines.

Can you confirm the following so we can escalate properly to deal desk:
- Target 12-month ACV and forecasted monthly usage (tokens/embeddings estimates)
- Any revenue/marketing co-funding expectations (co-sell credits, NFR)
- TopSpin procurement contact for contract and PO

I'm attaching the draft SOW and the pricing model we're proposing. At first pass I think this qualifies for a marketplace private-offer exception but will need a documented commitment. If you can send the procurement contact and expected ACV by EOD Tue, we'll try to fast-track to the marketplace team.

Attachments: TopSpin_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing-model.xlsx

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Elena Torres <elena@topspin.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pricing exception request — TopSpin AWS co-sell bundle

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks — happy to move quickly. Quick answers:
- Procurement prefers a 12-month term with a $420k ACV (they called out predictable monthly consumption; I attached the RFQ they gave us)
- They still want the 35% off list but are open to a blended approach: 25% off list + $50k co-sell / marketing credit
- Procurement lead is Maria Alvarez (maria.alvarez@topspin.ai) and cc'd procurement@topspin.ai on this thread for records

I'm attaching the RFQ so you can see the gating items. If you need a formal redline or a shorter payment term, let me know. TopSpin is trying to align ahead of their board meeting the week of Apr 26.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Partnerships, TopSpin AI
elena@topspin.ai

Attachments: procurement-rfq.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@topspin.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing exception request — Pricing exception request — TopSpin AWS co-sell bundle

Looping in Deal Desk / Marketplace owners.

Summary: TopSpin wants 35% off list on a 12-month AWS private offer for $420k ACV. Procurement suggests alternate: 25% + $50k co-sell credit. They need final terms ahead of board week (Apr 26).

Proposed internal path:
- Option A (preferred by customer): 35% off list as a one-time private-offer concession; requires marketplace waiver and Sales Leader approval.
- Option B (compromise): 25% off list + $50k co-sell credit + 60-day payment term. This should be approvable by Deal Desk with Aditya sign-off if marketplace policy allows embedded credits.

Ask to Rafael: can you confirm whether AWS private-offer policy allows the co-sell credit to be included on the offer line-item (so it shows in marketplace pricing)? If not, what's the alternative (separate MSA credit or marketing fund)?

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/record/TS-2027-041 (deal details + forecasted consumption attached)

Thanks — timeboxed to EOD Thu (Apr 22) since TopSpin must present terms to board week of Apr 26.

-Aditya
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing exception request — Pricing exception request — TopSpin AWS co-sell bundle

Thanks for the summary. A few clarifying Qs from the marketplace side:
1) Is the $420k ACV guaranteed (signed PO) or forecasted pipeline? Marketplace waivers require committed revenue vs pipeline quotes.
2) If we do Option B (25% + $50k credit), how do we want the credit reflected (line-item discount vs separate marketing rebate)? AWS typically expects the price shown in the private offer to reflect customer invoice price; marketing credits are often executed outside marketplace which complicates co-sell reporting.
3) Any required term, termination or audit clauses from TopSpin procurement we should be aware of?

If ACV is committed and we accept Option B with the credit executed as a rebate outside the private-offer, I think Deal Desk + Marketplace can approve at my level, subject to finance sign-off on the credit. If they truly need the 35% on-list inside the private-offer, that will require a higher-level waiver and will push timeline ~3–5 business days for legal/marketplace review.

Please attach the redline SOW and final procurement RFQ here and tag Finance so they can review the $50k credit impact.

-Rafael
Director, Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@topspin.ai>, Procurement <procure@topspin.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing exception request — Pricing exception request — TopSpin AWS co-sell bundle

Rafael / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final answers and asks below so Deal Desk/Finance can decide quickly:

- ACV: TopSpin confirmed a signed PO is in process; legal confirmed a purchase order commitment (draft PO) for $420k to be executed within 7 days of terms sign-off. I'll attach the draft PO and the redline SOW.
- Preferred structure: TopSpin prefers all commercial concessions visible in the private-offer for procurement transparency. If we cannot surface the $50k credit inside the private-offer, they will accept Option B with an off-marketplace rebate but it reduces their willingness to proceed.
- Other constraints: TopSpin needs 60-day payment terms and a standard data residency clause.

Attachments: TopSpin_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing-model.xlsx, procurement-rfq.pdf, TopSpin_PO_draft.pdf

Requested approvals:
- Deal Desk / Marketplace (Rafael): Can we approve Option B as a quick path if Finance signs the $50k credit as a separate rebate? If possible, confirm by EOD Apr 22 so we can get a signed PO before board week.
- If Deal Desk requires a waiver for Option A (35% in-marketplace), please confirm the escalation owner and ETA for approval.

If helpful, I can hop on a 20-min call this afternoon with Rafael and Finance to unblock.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147
